stem: ![](asset:P000362-stem-1)  The machine as shown has 2 rods of length 1 m connected by a pivot at the top. The end of one rod is connected to the floor by a stationary pivot and the end of the other rod has a roller that rolls along the floor in a slot. As the roller goes back and forth, a 2 kg weight moves up and down. If the roller is moving towards right at a constant speed, the weight moves up with a :

options.D: speed which is 3/4th of that of the roller when the weight is 0.4 m above the ground

assets.alt: A frame of two equal rods hinged at the top, where a 2 kg block sits. The lower right end is a fixed pivot; the lower left end is a movable roller pushed by force F. The lower ends are a distance x apart.
